title: Master Thesis — Adaptive Feedback Loop (Single View)

list.name: scenario
list.label: Scenario
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "${bucket}", tag: "scenario", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "water_pipeline" and r.run_id =~ /^${run_id}$/)

list.name: site_id
list.label: Site
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "${bucket}", tag: "site_id", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "water_pipeline" and r.run_id =~ /^${run_id}$/ and r.scenario =~ /^${scenario}$/)

list.name: sample_kind
list.label: Sample Kind
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "${bucket}", tag: "sample_kind", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "water_pipeline" and r.run_id =~ /^${run_id}$/ and r.scenario =~ /^${scenario}$/ and r.site_id =~ /^${site_id}$/)

panels.title: A) Feedback Loop Timeline (CAUSE → DECIDE → ACT → EFFECT)
Leak (Truth vs Detected) — CAUSE (truth is evaluation-only)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "water_pipeline")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.run_id =~ /^${run_id}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario =~ /^${scenario}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.site_id =~ /^${site_id}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.sample_kind =~ /^${sample_kind}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "leak_truth" or r._field == "leak_detected")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["site_id", "_field"])

panels.title: Cloud CPU Usage % — CAUSE (resource signal used by controller)
Controller Decisions per 10s — DECIDE (fallback if annotations are hard to see)
Edge Mode (mode_code) — ACT (0=NORMAL, 1=DEBUG, 2=ECONOMY)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "water_pipeline")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.run_id =~ /^${run_id}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario =~ /^${scenario}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.site_id =~ /^${site_id}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.sample_kind =~ /^${sample_kind}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "mode_code")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["site_id"])

panels.title: Bandwidth Rate — EFFECT (bytes/sec, shows DEBUG spikes & ECONOMY savings)
A2) Controller Audit (Why decisions happened)
Controller Audit Log — target_mode / reason / cooldown + cpu/memory

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "controller_audit")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.run_id =~ /^${run_id}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario =~ /^${scenario}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.site_id =~ /^${site_id}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "cpu_pct" or r._field == "memory_pct" or r._field == "leak_detected" or r._field == "cooldown_active" or r._field == "current_mode" or r._field == "target_mode" or r._field == "reason")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5s, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "site_id", "cpu_pct", "memory_pct", "leak_detected", "cooldown_active", "current_mode", "target_mode", "reason"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 200)

panels.title: B) Latency & Performance (What your modes cost)
End-to-End Latency (p50 / p95) — Sensor → Influx write
Network vs Processing Latency (p95)
Staleness (Freshness) — EFFECT (staleness_s)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "water_pipeline")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.run_id =~ /^${run_id}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario =~ /^${scenario}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.site_id =~ /^${site_id}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.sample_kind =~ /^${sample_kind}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "staleness_s")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["site_id"])

panels.title: C) Reliability & Backpressure (What breaks under load)
MQTT Message Flow (arrived / buffered / dropped per sec)
Subscriber Queue Depth (buffer gauge)
InfluxDB Writes (success vs fail per sec)
Edge Egress + Local Leak Detections (per sec)
D) Water Telemetry (What the system is monitoring)
Pressure (psi) & Flow (gpm) — per site (mean)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "water_pipeline")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.run_id =~ /^${run_id}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario =~ /^${scenario}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.site_id =~ /^${site_id}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.sample_kind =~ /^${sample_kind}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "pressure_psi" or r._field == "flow_gpm")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["site_id", "_field"])

panels.title: Uplink Mix — Points per 10s by sample_kind (proxy via pressure_psi count)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "water_pipeline")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.run_id =~ /^${run_id}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario =~ /^${scenario}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.site_id =~ /^${site_id}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "pressure_psi")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: count, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["sample_kind"])
